title: Large Language Models are Not Yet Human-Level Evaluators for Abstractive Summarization

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating a meta-correlation metric to quantify how the LLM's evaluation reliability (alignment with human judgment) fluctuates depending on the overall quality and identity of the specific summarization system being evaluated, revealing if the LLM unfairly favors or disfavors certain candidates.

Conducting head-to-head (H2H) comparisons twice by swapping the presentation order of the candidate summaries (Summary #1 and Summary #2) to mitigate and account for the LLM's potential bias toward the layout or ID of the inputs.
